overview.en:
Operate HubSpot CRM records, pipelines, activities, workflows, reports, data quality, sales execution, support, retention, ownership, and quote-to-cash through all 15 official Agent CLI skills.

Connect company, contact, and sales context to a concrete account review. Use a named account or pipeline and prepare proposed follow-up work with its supporting records.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
管理 CRM 记录、销售管道、工作流、报表、客户支持与业务数据。

把企业、联系人和销售上下文用于具体的客户复盘。指定客户或销售管道，并在后续行动建议中附上对应记录。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this account's available records and recent sales context.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个客户的可用记录与近期销售背景。

starterPrompts.en: Review this pipeline and identify opportunities that need follow-up.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这个销售管道，找出需要跟进的商机。

starterPrompts.en: Draft a follow-up plan for this account using the recorded context.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据已有记录，为这个客户起草跟进计划。
